recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If a future work group decision specifically requires generated table hover text, open a new tooling-focused issue; do not add redundant registry prose for FHIR-20762.
issue_request: FHIR-20762 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked that the SearchParameter registry make the full canonical URL for a type/code search parameter easier to discover, originally suggesting a type/code/url table and links to SearchParameter resources; the accepted resolution preferred avoiding repeated URL bases and suggested exposing the full URL as a flyover.
initial_application: No FHIR-20762-tagged implementation commit was found in the current repository history. The registry already had canonical URL construction text before the Jira was filed, and current source keeps that guidance plus XML/JSON links. The later Jira assignee comment says the clinical-* URL concern had already been addressed by resource-specific URLs and that no source change was needed.
additional_context: The registry is in current build scope through source/hierarchy.xml, and SearchParameter is active in source/fhir.ini. source/searchparameter-registry.html states that canonical URLs use http://hl7.org/fhir/SearchParameter/[id] with [id] from the table. Source SearchParameter bundles use resource-specific ids/URLs such as Condition-patient. FHIR-38728, a later same-family discoverability issue, is already represented on the combined branch and links resource search pages back to the registry. FHIR-20762-specific Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Adding a URL column or extra explanatory prose would duplicate the existing canonical-URL rule and conflict with the accepted resolution's concern about visual noise. The remaining literal per-row flyover behavior would be a publisher/generation enhancement if the work group still wants it, not a necessary current source fix for this applied issue.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive search-parameter discoverability issue that links resource search pages to the registry; it is already represented on the combined branch and was cited only as related context.
